findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 23 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Chemistry Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 21 questions numbered 1-21; by section: 23.1 1, 23.2 1, 23.3 5, 23.4 3, 23.5 4, 23.6 3, 23.7 2, 23.8 1, 23.9 1.

Theory parts cover the preparation of ethanal and propanone, structure and reactivity of >C=O, addition of HCN, hydride reduction, 2,4-DNPH, Tollens', Fehling's and iodoform tests, carboxylic acids and their preparation, reactions of the acidic H, replacement of -OH and reduction, oxidation of methanoic and ethanedioic acids, relative acidities, esters (properties, preparation, hydrolysis), acyl chlorides and hydrolysis of chlorides. Numericals (oxidation numbers and mole ratio in the KMnO₄/ethanedioic acid equation, pKa from Ka, Ka of the chloro-acids) use values recomputed in Python. Book corrections followed (ethanal from ethanol, 2-hydroxy-2-methylpropanenitrile, 2,4-DNPH, sodium ethanoate from propanone, ethanol oxidised to ethanal first, -COO⁻ delocalisation, +I of CH₃, ethyl ethanoate more volatile; the '14 days' figure is not used).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
